  NOTE "This nutrition plan supports breastfeeding and postpartum recovery. All targets are general guidelines. Refer client to a registered dietitian for personalised advice, especially if she has gestational diabetes history, food allergies, or supply concerns."

  CALORIES
    baseline 2300 kcal
    breastfeeding_surplus 500 kcal
    total_target 2300 kcal
    NOTE "Breastfeeding requires approximately 400-500 kcal above pre-pregnancy maintenance. Total target assumes a moderate pre-pregnancy maintenance of ~1800 kcal. Do not restrict calories below 1800 kcal while exclusively breastfeeding — this risks milk supply and recovery."

  MACROS
    protein 110g NOTE "Supports tissue repair post C-section and preserves lean mass. Target ~1.5g per kg bodyweight assuming ~73kg."
    carbohydrates 290g NOTE "Primary fuel for milk production and energy. Prioritise complex sources: oats, rice, sweet potato, legumes."
    fat 85g NOTE "Essential for hormone recovery and fat-soluble vitamin absorption. Prioritise omega-3 rich sources: oily fish, walnuts, flaxseed."

  HYDRATION
    target 3.0 litres daily
    NOTE "Breastfeeding increases fluid needs significantly. Client should drink a large glass of water at every feed. Urine should remain pale yellow."

  MEAL_TIMING
    meals_per_day 5
    NOTE "Three main meals and two snacks. Eating every 3-4 hours supports stable energy, milk supply, and prevents the extreme hunger that disrupts food choices in new mothers."

  MEAL_PLAN
    MEAL breakfast "Overnight Oats with Berries and Seeds":
      NOTE "Oats support milk supply (galactagogue properties). Chia seeds add omega-3 and fibre."
      targets: protein 20g carbs 55g fat 14g calories 430 kcal

    MEAL snack_1 "Greek Yoghurt with Walnuts and Honey":
      NOTE "Quick, one-handed snack suitable for feeding sessions. High calcium supports bone density recovery."
      targets: protein 18g carbs 22g fat 10g calories 250 kcal

    MEAL lunch "Salmon and Sweet Potato Bowl with Leafy Greens":
      NOTE "Oily fish provides DHA critical for infant brain development via breast milk. Aim for 2 portions of oily fish per week. Avoid high-mercury fish (swordfish, shark, marlin)."
      targets: protein 35g carbs 55g fat 18g calories 530 kcal

    MEAL snack_2 "Wholegrain Toast with Nut Butter and Banana":
      NOTE "Sustained energy for afternoon. Banana provides potassium and quick carbohydrate."
      targets: protein 10g carbs 45g fat 12g calories 330 kcal

    MEAL dinner "Chicken, Lentil and Vegetable Stew":
      NOTE "Iron-rich meal to address postpartum iron depletion. Lentils also support milk supply. Pair with vitamin C source to enhance iron absorption."
      targets: protein 40g carbs 60g fat 14g calories 530 kcal

  MICRONUTRIENTS
    PRIORITY iron:
      target 9mg daily
      NOTE "Postpartum iron stores are often depleted. Red meat 2x per week, lentils, spinach, fortified cereals. Pair with vitamin C. Avoid tea and coffee within 1 hour of iron-rich meals."
    PRIORITY calcium:
      target 1000mg daily
      NOTE "Breastfeeding draws heavily on calcium stores. Dairy, fortified plant milks, leafy greens, tinned fish with bones."
    PRIORITY vitamin_D:
      target 10mcg daily
      NOTE "Supplement recommended year-round in northern latitudes. Supports calcium absorption and immune function for mother and infant."
    PRIORITY omega_3:
      target 200mg DHA daily
      NOTE "Critical for infant neurological development. Oily fish 2x per week or algae-based DHA supplement if fish intake is low."
    PRIORITY iodine:
      target 200mcg daily
      NOTE "Essential for infant thyroid and brain development. Dairy, eggs, white fish, iodised salt. Many prenatal vitamins do not contain iodine — check label."

NUTRITION
  NOTE "This nutrition plan supports breastfeeding and postpartum recovery. All targets are general guidelines. Refer client to a registered dietitian for personalised advice, especially if she has gestational diabetes history, food allergies, or supply concerns."

  CALORIES
    baseline 2300 kcal
    breastfeeding_surplus 500 kcal
    total_target 2300 kcal
    NOTE "Breastfeeding requires approximately 400-500 kcal above pre-pregnancy maintenance. Total target assumes a moderate pre-pregnancy maintenance of ~1800 kcal. Do not restrict calories below 1800 kcal while exclusively breastfeeding — this risks milk supply and recovery."

  MACROS
    protein 110g NOTE "Supports tissue repair post C-section and preserves lean mass. Target ~1.5g per kg bodyweight assuming ~73kg."
    carbohydrates 290g NOTE "Primary fuel for milk production and energy. Prioritise complex sources: oats, rice, sweet potato, legumes."
    fat 85g NOTE "Essential for hormone recovery and fat-soluble vitamin absorption. Prioritise omega-3 rich sources: oily fish, walnuts, flaxseed."

  HYDRATION
    target 3.0 litres daily
    NOTE "Breastfeeding increases fluid needs significantly. Client should drink a large glass of water at every feed. Urine should remain pale yellow."

  MEAL_TIMING
    meals_per_day 5
    NOTE "Three main meals and two snacks. Eating every 3-4 hours supports stable energy, milk supply, and prevents the extreme hunger that disrupts food choices in new mothers."

  MEAL_PLAN
    MEAL breakfast "Overnight Oats with Berries and Seeds":
      NOTE "Oats support milk supply (galactagogue properties). Chia seeds add omega-3 and fibre."
      targets: protein 20g carbs 55g fat 14g calories 430 kcal

    MEAL snack_1 "Greek Yoghurt with Walnuts and Honey":
      NOTE "Quick, one-handed snack suitable for feeding sessions. High calcium supports bone density recovery."
      targets: protein 18g carbs 22g fat 10g calories 250 kcal

    MEAL lunch "Salmon and Sweet Potato Bowl with Leafy Greens":
      NOTE "Oily fish provides DHA critical for infant brain development via breast milk. Aim for 2 portions of oily fish per week. Avoid high-mercury fish (swordfish, shark, marlin)."
      targets: protein 35g carbs 55g fat 18g calories 530 kcal

    MEAL snack_2 "Wholegrain Toast with Nut Butter and Banana":
      NOTE "Sustained energy for afternoon. Banana provides potassium and quick carbohydrate."
      targets: protein 10g carbs 45g fat 12g calories 330 kcal

    MEAL dinner "Chicken, Lentil and Vegetable Stew":
      NOTE "Iron-rich meal to address postpartum iron depletion. Lentils also support milk supply. Pair with vitamin C source to enhance iron absorption."
      targets: protein 40g carbs 60g fat 14g calories 530 kcal

  MICRONUTRIENTS
    PRIORITY iron:
      target 9mg daily
      NOTE "Postpartum iron stores are often depleted. Red meat 2x per week, lentils, spinach, fortified cereals. Pair with vitamin C. Avoid tea and coffee within 1 hour of iron-rich meals."
    PRIORITY calcium:
      target 1000mg daily
      NOTE "Breastfeeding draws heavily on calcium stores. Dairy, fortified plant milks, leafy greens, tinned fish with bones."
    PRIORITY vitamin_D:
      target 10mcg daily
      NOTE "Supplement recommended year-round in northern latitudes. Supports calcium absorption and immune function for mother and infant."
    PRIORITY omega_3:
      target 200mg DHA daily
      NOTE "Critical for infant neurological development. Oily fish 2x per week or algae-based DHA supplement if fish intake is low."
    PRIORITY iodine:
      target 200mcg daily
      NOTE "Essential for infant thyroid and brain development. Dairy, eggs, white fish, iodised salt. Many prenatal vitamins do not contain iodine — check label."
    PRIORITY folate:
      target 400mcg daily
      NOTE "Continue prenatal supplement or ensure dietary folate from leafy greens, legumes, fortified foods."

  SUPPLEMENTS
    RECOMMEND postnatal_multivitamin:
      NOTE "Continue a postnatal multivitamin throughout breastfeeding. Ensures baseline micronutrient coverage on days when diet is disrupted by newborn demands."
    RECOMMEND vitamin_D:
      dose 10mcg daily
      NOTE "Recommend to GP or midwife that infant also receives vitamin D drops 8.5-10mcg daily if exclusively breastfed, per NHS guidance."
    RECOMMEND omega_3_DHA:
      NOTE "Algae-based DHA 200-300mg daily if oily fish intake is below 2 portions per week. Algae-based is safe, sustainable, and avoids mercury concerns."
    CAUTION caffeine:
      NOTE "Limit to 200mg per day (approximately 2 cups of coffee). Caffeine passes into breast milk and may affect infant sleep."
    CAUTION alcohol:
      NOTE "Avoid or minimise. If consumed, wait at least 2 hours per unit before feeding or pump and discard."

  CALORIES
    baseline 2300 kcal
    breastfeeding_surplus 500 kcal
    total_target 2300 kcal
    NOTE "Breastfeeding requires approximately 400-500 kcal above pre-pregnancy maintenance. Total target assumes a moderate pre-pregnancy maintenance of ~1800 kcal. Do not restrict calories below 1800 kcal while exclusively breastfeeding — this risks milk supply and recovery."

  MACROS
    protein 110g NOTE "Supports tissue repair post C-section and preserves lean mass. Target ~1.5g per kg bodyweight assuming ~73kg."
    carbohydrates 290g NOTE "Primary fuel for milk production and energy. Prioritise complex sources: oats, rice, sweet potato, legumes."
    fat 85g NOTE "Essential for hormone recovery and fat-soluble vitamin absorption. Prioritise omega-3 rich sources: oily fish, walnuts, flaxseed."

  HYDRATION
    target 3.0 litres daily
    NOTE "Breastfeeding increases fluid needs significantly. Client should drink a large glass of water at every feed. Urine should remain pale yellow."

  MEAL_TIMING
    meals_per_day 5
    NOTE "Three main meals and two snacks. Eating every 3-4 hours supports stable energy, milk supply, and prevents the extreme hunger that disrupts food choices in new mothers."

  MEAL_PLAN
    MEAL breakfast "Overnight Oats with Berries and Seeds":
      NOTE "Oats support milk supply (galactagogue properties). Chia seeds add omega-3 and fibre."
      targets: protein 20g carbs 55g fat 14g calories 430 kcal

    MEAL snack_1 "Greek Yoghurt with Walnuts and Honey":
      NOTE "Quick, one-handed snack suitable for feeding sessions. High calcium supports bone density recovery."
      targets: protein 18g carbs 22g fat 10g calories 250 kcal

    MEAL lunch "Salmon and Sweet Potato Bowl with Leafy Greens":
      NOTE "Oily fish provides DHA critical for infant brain development via breast milk. Aim for 2 portions of oily fish per week. Avoid high-mercury fish (swordfish, shark, marlin)."
      targets: protein 35g carbs 55g fat 18g calories 530 kcal

    MEAL snack_2 "Wholegrain Toast with Nut Butter and Banana":
      NOTE "Sustained energy for afternoon. Banana provides potassium and quick carbohydrate."
      targets: protein 10g carbs 45g fat 12g calories 330 kcal

    MEAL dinner "Chicken, Lentil and Vegetable Stew":
      NOTE "Iron-rich meal to address postpartum iron depletion. Lentils also support milk supply. Pair with vitamin C source to enhance iron absorption."
      targets: protein 40g carbs 60g fat 14g calories 530 kcal

  MICRONUTRIENTS
    PRIORITY iron:
      target 9mg daily
      NOTE "Postpartum iron stores are often depleted. Red meat 2x per week, lentils, spinach, fortified cereals. Pair with vitamin C. Avoid tea and coffee within 1 hour of iron-rich meals."
    PRIORITY calcium:
      target 1000mg daily
      NOTE "Breastfeeding draws heavily on calcium stores. Dairy, fortified plant milks, leafy greens, tinned fish with bones."
    PRIORITY vitamin_D:
      target 10mcg daily
      NOTE "Supplement recommended year-round in northern latitudes. Supports calcium absorption and immune function for mother and infant."
    PRIORITY omega_3:
      target 200mg DHA daily
      NOTE "Critical for infant neurological development. Oily fish 2x per week or algae-based DHA supplement if fish intake is low."
    PRIORITY iodine:
      target 200mcg daily
      NOTE "Essential for infant thyroid and brain development. Dairy, eggs, white fish, iodised salt. Many prenatal vitamins do not contain iodine — check label."
    PRIORITY folate:
      target 400mcg daily
      NOTE "Continue prenatal supplement or ensure dietary folate from leafy greens, legumes, fortified foods."
